subject: Marketplace incentive exchange & supplier renewal coordination
messages:
From: CloudMarketplace Ops <ops@cloudmarket.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AWS Partner Programs <aws-partner@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace incentive exchange & upcoming renewal — action requested

Hi Irene / Vanessa,

Hope you’re both well. I’m reaching because our records show the Azure listing for Redwood Inference (ACME opportunity) is up for its annual renewal on 2026-10-12. We’d like to propose an updated commercial structure for the renewal that moves a portion of the historical upfront listing credit into a co-sell/marketplace incentive pool. High level:

- One-time listing fee stays at the published level but 40% of the prior listing credit would convert into a co-sell credit pool (usable against AWS co-sell qualified bookings).
- Listed partner fee (platform commission) will increase by 3% for 12 months to balance the exchange.
- We can offer a 6-month amortization schedule for any remaining listing credit balance.

Attached: Azure_Marketplace_Term_Summary.pdf and partner_credit_schedule.xlsx with the line-item math.

We need a signed SOW by EOD 2026-10-05 to hit the Oct marketplace cycle. If Redwood prefers to keep the credit as a pure listing rebate (no conversion), we’ll need a trade: additional marketing co-fund or a smaller annual fee bump.

Can you confirm who should own negotiation on Redwood side and whether you want to accept the exchange, propose counter-structure, or request a straight listing credit?

Best,
Lila Mendes
Partner Programs — CloudMarketplace Ops
attachments: Azure_Marketplace_Term_Summary.pdf (PDF), partner_credit_schedule.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace incentive exchange & upcoming renewal — action requested

Team —

Quick read-through of Lila’s proposal. High level reaction and recommended approach:

1) Risk profile: ACME is price sensitive and prefers predictable line items on their buy-side. Converting to co-sell credits increases complexity for them and may reduce perceived value. That raises churn risk for this pilot account.

2) Negotiation levers we should use: marketing co-fund, guaranteed co-sell qualification commitment, or a longer amortization window (9–12 months) rather than 6.

3) Concession authority: I can approve up to a $120k effective concession (one-time equivalent) without pulling finance, provided we trade for a 6% minimum guaranteed marketing co-fund and an AWS co-sell QBR commitment. Anything above $120k needs manager approval from Marcus.

Ask: Marissa — please draft a commercial redline that proposes: keep 60% as listing rebate, convert 40% to conditional co-sell credits with a 9-month amortization, and require a minimum $75k marketing co-fund payable within quarter. Also capture fallback language that if co-sell credits aren’t usable after 3 months, they convert back to a listing rebate.

Karthik — pls run numbers for the impact to our ARR recognition and cash timing if we accept the 6 vs 9 month amortization options. Marcus — I’ll loop you if the final ask exceeds the approved concession.

I’m copying Lila’s original note below for context.

— Irene Choi
Partnerships Lead | Redwood Inference
irene@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0219

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: CloudMarketplace Ops <ops@cloudmarket.com>, Procurement - ACME Analytics <procure@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 11:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace incentive exchange & upcoming renewal — proposed redlines attached

Hi Lila / ACME procurement team,

Thanks for the note and the schedules. Attached is our proposed redline (redlined_sow_irm.docx) that reflects the counter Irene outlined:

- 60% of current listing credit remains as a listing rebate payable at activation.
- 40% convertible to co-sell credits with a 9-month amortization; credits only redeemable against co-sell qualified bookings with a maximum transfer-out prohibition.
- Minimum $75k marketing co-fund payable within 60 days after effective date.
- Fallback clause: if co-sell credits are not actionable within 90 days, remaining balance auto-converts to listing rebate.

We’ve also included a clean SOW template for signature that matches the accounting language Redwood needs to recognize revenue in the quarter (please see the accounting notes in paragraph 7).

Please review and return an updated SOW or counter by 2026-10-08 so we can finalize for the Oct cycle.

Attachments: redlined_sow_irm.docx

Thanks — Marissa
Director, GTM Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-0137

From: CloudMarketplace Ops <ops@cloudmarket.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement - ACME Analytics <procure@acmeanalytics.com>, AWS Partner Programs <aws-partner@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 16:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace incentive exchange & upcoming renewal — SOW v3 and signature link

Marissa / Irene —

Appreciate the turnaround. We reviewed your redline and accepted the 60/40 split with the 9-month amortization and the fallback clause. We made minor edits to the legal boilerplate and updated the partner fee table to reflect a 2.5% bump (vs the 3% originally proposed) as a good-faith concession.

Attached: SOW_Azure_Renewal_v3.docx (clean), partner_credit_schedule.xlsx (updated with 2.5% fee impact).

Next steps:
- Please confirm internal approval and sign the attached SOW by 2026-10-12 to secure the Oct marketplace batch.
- We’re sending a DocuSign envelope; look for email from docusign@e-sign.com with Subject: "Redwood Inference — Azure Marketplace Renewal".

If you need Marcus to sign or any finance sign-off, let me know and I’ll extend the signature window by 48 hours.

Best regards,
Lila Mendes
Partner Programs — CloudMarketplace Ops
attachments: SOW_Azure_Renewal_v3.docx, partner_credit_schedule.xlsx
